title: BPW-2026-0610
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0610
CD ALL
The Mayor and City Council have approved and authorized the Board of Public Works, on behalf of the Bureau of Sanitation, to execute the revised proposed contract between the Public Works Bureau of Sanitation and NS Corporation for the maintenance and repair of automated vehicle wash facilities for a not-to-exceed cost of $1,400,000 and a term of five years with one five year extension and an optional six-month extension on a month-to-month basis for a total potential term of 10 years and six months.
(REF: BPW-2026-0516)
